get.description:
The order with its breadcrumb trail (down to its location), report, and stored
invoice.

Documents, conditions (with inspections and photos), and notes logged around the
order: those PestPac links to it, then its location's from within a day of the work
date (`link` says which).
Notes PestPac associates with this order (e.g. the technician's service notes).

put.description: Save credentials, then test them against PestPac. The response carries the result.

get.description: Render a template with the location's data and return the PDF.

post.description: Render unsaved template HTML with a location's data, for template authors.

Start a report for one of the location's service orders, with its notes and photos
dated near the work date offered for selection.

patch.description:
Edit a draft: field values, which notes the narrative is drafted from, and which photos
appear (in order, with captions).

post.description:
Queue the narrative draft: the selected notes go to the LLM with the template's prompt;
the reply fills the template's LLM fields. Runs in the worker; poll the report.

get.description: The report as HTML, rendered from its saved data exactly as the PDF will be.

post.description: Render the PDF from the saved data, store it, and lock the report.
Start a new draft revision from a final report's data.

get.description: The stored PDF of a final report.

Operators, companies, bill-tos, locations, service orders, and invoices matching `q`,
limited to what the caller can open. Names match anywhere; ids and numbers match exactly.

post.description:
PestPac webhook deliveries. Public (PestPac holds no session); authenticity comes from
the HMAC signature. Answers the same whether the event was stored, dropped, or a
redelivery, so callers can't probe which bill-tos are onboarded.

GoCanvas webhook requests for one operator. Public; every request is stored as received
(headers minus credentials, body, IP, user agent) until GoCanvas's format is known. Answers
the same for unknown operators, so the URL can't be used to probe them.

get.description:
Stored PestPac webhook deliveries, newest first. Deliveries dropped by the bill-to rule
are never stored, so they don't appear here.
Requests received at the operator's GoCanvas webhook URL, newest first.

Service activity for a company, or one of its bill-tos. Findings, programs, and risk
metrics are not available yet (see docs/customer-dashboard-plan.md).

CompanyMemberRead.title: CompanyMemberRead

Crumb.title: Crumb

GoCanvasRequestRead.title: GoCanvasRequestRead
GoCanvasRequestRead.description: A received GoCanvas request, without its body.

InvoiceRead.title: InvoiceRead

InvoicedOrderRead.title: InvoicedOrderRead

PestPacBillToDetails.title: PestPacBillToDetails
PestPacBillToDetails.description:
Identifying details of a PestPac bill-to. Only these fields are kept; the rest of the
GET /BillTos/{id} response (balances, credit and collection data, contacts) is discarded.

PestPacConnectionWrite.title: PestPacConnectionWrite
PestPacConnectionWrite.description: Secrets are write-only. Omit one to keep the stored value (required on first setup).

ReportPhotoItem.title: ReportPhotoItem

An image dated near the order's work date. Selected ones appear in the report, in
list order, with their caption.

ReportPreview.title: ReportPreview

Unsaved template HTML, rendered against a real location; `fields` get sample values
(and the sample order, conditions, and photos stand in) so every part can be checked.

ReportSummary.title: ReportSummary

the notes when selected.

ReportUpdate.title: ReportUpdate
